body:
Credit to @Jirentian for the report (a hand-installed plugin's provider fell back to the generic glyph whatever icon name it declared). The patch itself, for `git am` (fixing my post above, which linked only the branch):
patch (git am applies it as is; SHA-256 first 16: e72581f4aaa2a8e4) ``` From 724edc87d779c470b8067bd5e45a50c4b72f1c05 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001 From: ggbdpq Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:31:29 +0800 Subject: [PATCH] provider: a plugin saying a built-in icon's name for its provider had it shown A plugin provider's icon was the picture its auth hook or package.json gave (kept as a user's picture is) or the market's, and a bare name said in either place was refused by both readers: host.js's iconOf carried only an https URL or a data:image URI, and pluginOwnIcon asked iconURL of it, which takes a URL. The market's own bare names went through (MarketIcon), so a plugin the market lists showed its mark and one installed by hand showed the generic glyph, whatever it said (#5103). A bare name (no scheme, no path) now passes both readers as it is, as a market name does; the page draws it from its bundled icons, falling back to the generic glyph for one it has no file of. A picture is still checked, fetched and kept as before. Fixes #5103 Generated-by: GLM-5.3-Flash (ZCode) --- internal/plugin/host.js | 11 +++--- internal/plugin/plugin_icon_test.go | 5 +++ internal/plugin/testdata/ownicon/index.js | 8 +++++ internal/provider/plugin_icon.go | 8 +++-- internal/provider/plugin_icon_name_test.go | 42 ++++++++++++++++++++++ 5 files changed, 68 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-) create mode 100644 internal/provider/plugin_icon_name_test.go diff --git a/internal/plugin/host.js b/internal/plugin/host.js index 1f54881f2..b3338a03b 100644 --- a/internal/plugin/host.js +++ b/internal/plugin/host.js @@ -2185,13 +2185,16 @@ function methods(auth) { // iconOf is the picture a plugin gives its provider, magpie's own field // (OpenCode's providers have none): the auth hook's icon, else -// package.json's magpie.icon. An https URL or a data:image URI; magpie -// checks and keeps it (internal/provider), nothing is fetched here. +// package.json's magpie.icon. An https URL, a data:image URI, or the name +// of an icon magpie bundles, which the page draws from its own files +// (#5103); magpie checks and keeps a picture (internal/provider), nothing +// is fetched here. function iconOf(a) { const ok = (v) => { const s = typeof v === "string" ? v.trim() : "" - // a data URI of a picture over 1 MB, magpie's most, isn't carried - return s.length <= 3 << 19 && /^(https:\/\/|data:image\/)/i.test(s) ? s : "" + // a data URI of a picture over 1 MB, magpie's most, isn't carried; + // a bare name has neither a scheme nor a path in it + return s.length <= 3 << 19 && (s !== "" && !/[:/]/.test(s) || /^(https:\/\/|data:image\/)/i.test(s)) ? s : "" } const own = ok(a.auth.icon) if (own || !a.target) return own diff --git a/internal/plugin/plugin_icon_test.go b/internal/plugin/plugin_icon_test.go index 5cca7c7b1..29ad89827 100644 --- a/internal/plugin/plugin_icon_test.go +++ b/internal/plugin/plugin_icon_test.go @@ -36,6 +36,11 @@ func TestPluginOwnIconAndKeyHint(t *testing.T) { if lime.Icon != "https://ownicon.example/icon.png" { t.Errorf("lime's icon = %q, want package.json's", lime.Icon) } + // a built-in icon's name said for a provider comes through as it is + // (#5103): the page draws it from its bundle + if by["orange"].Icon != "deepseek-color" { + t.Errorf("orange's icon = %q, want the built-in name as it is", by["orange"].Icon) + } // how many requests each account takes at once (Discord, Lemon): the // auth hook's, else package.json's when the hook's isn't a whole number if lemon.MaxConcurrency != 3 || lime.MaxConcurrency != 5 { diff --git a/internal/plugin/testdata/ownicon/index.js b/internal/plugin/testdata/ownicon/index.js index 7f1a00985..9eb30ba62 100644 --- a/internal/plugin/testdata/ownicon/index.js +++ b/internal/plugin/testdata/ownicon/index.js @@ -25,3 +25,11 @@ export const Lime = async () => ({ methods: [{ type: "api", label: "API key", placeholder: 42 }], }, }) + +export const Orange = async () => ({ + auth: { + provider: "orange", + icon: "deepseek-color", // a built-in icon's name, given as it is (#5103) + methods: [{ type: "api", label: "Orange API key" }], + }, +}) diff --git a/internal/provider/plugin_icon.go b/internal/provider/plugin_icon.go index 2f8c4acce..6a79b301c 100644 --- a/internal/provider/plugin_icon.go +++ b/internal/provider/plugin_icon.go @@ -88,12 +88,16 @@ func keepPlugIcon(k, icon string) { // pluginOwnIcon is the Icon value of the picture a plugin gave, "" while // there is none to show. A data:image URI is kept at once; an https URL // is fetched in the background, through FetchIcon's checks, and shows -// once it is in (a failure is tried again in an hour). Anything else is -// refused. +// once it is in (a failure is tried again in an hour); a name without a +// scheme or a path is a bundled icon's, given as it is as a market one +// is (#5103). Anything else is refused. func pluginOwnIcon(said string) string { if said == "" { return "" } + if !MarketPicture(said) { + return said + } sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(said)) k := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:16]) plugIcons.Lock() diff --git a/internal/provider/plugin_icon_name_test.go b/internal/provider/plugin_icon_name_test.go new file mode 100644 index 000000000..2393a9146 --- /dev/null +++ b/internal/provider/plugin_icon_name_test.go @@ -0,0 +1,42 @@ +package provider + +import ( + "context" + "path/filepath" + "testing" + + "github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/plugin" +) + +// #5103 (Jirentian): a plugin's provider shown as the plain generic glyph +// while every other provider wears its vendor's mark. A plugin that says a +// built-in icon's name (magpie bundles their SVGs) for its provider had it +// shown: the market already hands such a name on as it is, and the page +// draws it from its bundle; the auth hook's and package.json's were the +// only two places one reached. One that says none still falls back to the +// market's, as before. +func TestPluginSaidIconName(t *testing.T) { + home := t.TempDir() + t.Setenv("HOME", home) + t.Setenv("USERPROFILE", home) + t.Setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".config")) + t.Setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", filepath.Join(home, ".cache")) + t.Setenv("MAGPIE_PLUGIN_MARKET", "off") + was := fetchPluginIcon + t.Cleanup(func() { fetchPluginIcon = was }) + fetchPluginIcon = func(context.Context, string) (string, error) { return "", nil } // never fetched in a test + + // a built-in icon's name passes as it is, where a URL is left to what + // it was: the name is shown, the rest kept or fetched as pluginOwnIcon + // does. A name no bundle has goes to the page as a market name does, + // which draws its generic glyph for it. + if ic := PluginIcon(plugin.Provider{ID: "deepseek", Spec: "lemon-plugin", Icon: "deepseek-color"}); ic != "deepseek-color" { + t.Errorf("a built-in name = %q, want deepseek-color", ic) + } + if ic := PluginIcon(plugin.Provider{ID: "lemon", Spec: "lemon-plugin", Icon: "no-such-icon-name"}); ic != "no-such-icon-name" { + t.Errorf("a bare name = %q, want it given as a market name is", ic) + } + if ic := PluginIcon(plugin.Provider{ID: "lemon", Spec: "lemon-plugin", Icon: "https://lemon.example/icon.png"}); ic != "" { + t.Errorf("a picture said = %q, want it kept as a picture is (not yet fetched)", ic) + } +} -- 2.50.1 (Apple Git-155) ```
Not verified: the Playwright GUI pass (browser deps not installed here — the change doesn't touch app.js; the data layer is locked by the Go tests), and visual rendering in the real app.
